parse_func: parse a PDDL function string into its name and list of arguments
create_ExprType: create a hierarchical PDDL expression type with an optional parent type for subtype checking
create_PddlEntity: create a frozen PDDL entity dataclass with a name and expression type for equality comparison
check_entity_lists_match: check if two lists of PDDL entities match in count and compatible argument types
get_entity_pos: get the 3D position of a PDDL entity from the simulator by its type
